The correlation coefficients between pH and the other measured parameters are all 1.0. This indicates that the dataset is highly redundant, meaning all variables are essentially measuring the same underlying property (pH). The model fit (R^2) is 1.0, confirming perfect predictability, but this is due to multicollinearity. The primary recommendation is to select only one pH column as the sole predictor due to the perfect linear dependence among all measured variables.
